settings.heading: Let’s talk art.
settings.text: Questions about a work, commissions, shipping or press — send a note to the studio.

settings.question: Do originals include authentication?
settings.answer: Yes. Every original arrives signed with a studio certificate of authenticity.

settings.question: How are works shipped?
settings.answer: All artwork is carefully packed. Originals travel insured with tracking; canvas prints are corner-protected and securely boxed.

settings.question: Can I see more detail first?
settings.answer: Of course. Ask for close-ups, scale images, or a short studio video of any available work.

settings.question: What is the difference between an original and a print?
settings.answer: An original is the one-of-one painting itself. A print is a matte stretched-canvas reproduction, signed and numbered by the artist.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: Every work can be seen drawn to scale on a wall. Open the size guide on any print page.
